note: Both sets struggle to accurately read values from the line plots, frequently misattributing values to the wrong wind speed curves. However, Set B makes more egregious errors by confusing the Power Coefficient and Thrust Coefficient contour plots (e.g., extracting a Thrust Coefficient of 0.480 and 0.420, which are Power Coefficient contour values). Set A is slightly better as it does not mix up the two contour plots.
